description: Return a Mint app link and durable download URL for a chosen animation artifact, plus filename/content type/format metadata. Requires ownership, a ready completed artifact, and download permission. Use mintUrl to open the source asset in Mint, and use downloadUrl directly for curl, R3F loaders, or game runtime code. The URL does not expose raw provider URLs, storage keys, provider job IDs, or Trigger IDs.
name: get_model_animation_artifact
title: Get Model Animation Artifact
